checks.falsifier: Any required checklist item is missing
checks.soWhat: Half-built venues draw a map but hide whole app features silently

checks.claim: Built bundle matches manifest counts and has a recipe
checks.falsifier: POI, ride, height, or path counts drift from manifest
checks.soWhat: The app reads manifest numbers; drift breaks trust in coverage badges

checks.claim: Path graph has ≤2 islands and every ride snaps to the network
checks.falsifier: OpenStreetMap path gaps strand rides on routing islands
checks.soWhat: Offline routing cannot reach a ride that is not on the walk network

checks.claim: Height rules present or declared absent
checks.falsifier: A park with rides ships without height filter coverage
checks.soWhat: Guests cannot filter by rider height offline without these rules

checks.claim: No height-chart headers or arcades ship as Rideable
checks.falsifier: OSM or height-chart ingest files amenity names as rides
checks.soWhat: Families see "Check at the ride" for places they cannot queue for

checks.claim: Queue entrances published at ≥moderate or recorded as proposals
checks.falsifier: No entrance evidence was inventoried for rideable attractions
checks.soWhat: Routing to a ride uses queue entrance coordinates when published

checks.falsifier: A blocking gap was papered over instead of recorded
checks.soWhat: Blocking requests mean a whole app feature is absent without saying so

checks.claim: Declared external adapters have caches or an honest gap note
checks.falsifier: sources.json lists a required adapter with no cache and no gaps.adapters note
checks.soWhat: Explore-more research sources must either feed the twin or show as an honest gap

checks.claim: Official park map image is local or LLM park-map search recorded candidates
checks.falsifier: sources.json lists official_map but no image and no LLM park-map search cache
checks.soWhat: Guest maps for tracing require LLM search (or a package maps/ image) before georef
